STORY
Разработчик на Хабре перестал брать самую умную и дорогую ИИ-модель для каждой задачи
Supported facts only:
- Главным критерием он выбрал стоимость выполненной задачи, а не максимальный intelligence index.

SPECIFIC SCENE TO DEPICT (approved plan for this slide)
Portrait editorial still life on a dark workbench: an oversized complex tool and a compact practical tool sit beside the same plain task sheet, viewed from a slight top angle. The scene represents choosing by task cost rather than maximum intelligence; no text, logos, UI or branding.
STORY-SPECIFIC ANCHOR (what makes this picture belong to THIS story)
The choice between the most intelligent model and a cheaper model is evaluated by the cost of completing the task.
WHAT MUST BE PHYSICALLY VISIBLE, AND WHY
Show a generated editorial still life: one oversized complex tool and one compact tool positioned beside the same plain task sheet on a dark workbench. The visual relationship is a deliberate choice between model capability and task cost, without text, logos or interface elements.
Slide purpose: Объяснить главный критерий выбора: стоимость выполненной задачи важнее максимального intelligence index.. Media function: concept.

OVERALL IDEA
Показать выбор ИИ-модели как практическое взвешивание: не максимальная мощность сама по себе, а соответствие конкретной задаче и её стоимости.
Visual genre: Единый мотив рабочего стола и принятия решения: тёмная фактура, красная направляющая линия и визуальное сопоставление сложного и практичного инструмента..

COMPOSITION FOR THIS SLIDE
one decisive focal subject with depth and intentional negative space for a headline. Portrait 4:5 editorial framing, one decisive focal point, believable depth and material detail.

SPECIFICITY
Depict THIS story's concrete idea so the picture communicates the story before the reader reads the text. The picture must not be reusable unchanged for ten unrelated AI posts. Do NOT produce a glowing cube, floating spheres or random geometry, a generic AI brain, an anonymous robot, a hologram, a cyberpunk city, an abstract monolith, neon circuitry or corporate technology stock art unless this story is literally about it.

COLOR / MOOD
Derive colour from the idea; contemporary, specific, cinematic or editorial, never generic.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
NO LOGOS. NO WORDMARKS. NO WATERMARKS. NO LARGE TEXT. NO READABLE TEXT OR LETTERING OF ANY KIND. NO FAKE UI. NO RANDOM INTERFACES. NO UNSUPPORTED PRODUCTS, FACTS, NUMBERS OR THIRD-PARTY BRANDING. Do not bake any headline into the image; the application adds the exact Russian copy and the canonical logo after generation.
